_about: Ordering rules that are not plain prerequisites: a quest that is lost, fails or will not start if another one happens first. Each pair means 'first' must be cleared before 'then'. Derived from the warnings in quests.json.

before.why: The Wisdom of Gaia is lost once both #1 and #5 are cleared.
The Wisdom of Gaia must be done before entering Gato Grottoes after The Flame of Hope.
Niccolo Part 2 says to do The Wisdom of Gaia first.
Where's Putty? is missed if #64 and #20 are both cleared first.
The Lost Princess disappears if you enter the Tower of Leires first.
Diddle's Letter will not trigger while Seeing Double is active.
Huntin' Du'Cate is missed if Catchin' Lilipeas is cleared first.
Daddy's Broom is missed once Heaven's Gate is cleared with 18 artifacts placed.
Daddy's Broom is missed once The Teardrop Crystal is cleared with 18 artifacts placed.
Daddy's Broom is missed once The Crimson Dragon is cleared with 18 artifacts placed.
Diddle Had It! cannot start while The Crimson Dragon is active.
The Flame of Hope will not start while Drowned Dreams is active.
The Seven Wisdoms needs Olbohn in the Underworld (Trembling Spoon from #30).
Li'l Cactus is lost if Cosmo is done first.
Catchin' Lilipeas will not start while The Dragon Princess is active.
Finish the Diddle arc before the Dragon arc ends (no Larc in party for #64/#16).
Love is Blind is lost if Geo's cafe triggers School Amour first.

requires.why: Instruments 101 opens after Reach for the Stars (#36), or via Geo (Tome of Magic from #19) and its four students.
Li'l Cactus starts after your first visit to Geo (Tome of Magic from #19).
